defects.where: signup-form.pdf, Type of act row (crop-1-1, crop-1-2)
defects.what: Radio circles are small and sit visibly below the label baseline; in the sample they are drawn larger and centred, so blank and filled versions don't match
Blank dropdown has no arrow or other affordance; it looks like a plain text box on screen and in print
Dead band of about 1.3 in between the signature/date row and the footer rule
Small box with a floating '1 to 6' hint leaves most of the row empty; the slot dropdown sits alone below the titles box, which breaks the grouping and the rhythm
Filled values are pure black Helvetica while labels are navy; plain un-embedded system Helvetica gives a generic look

GQFW.craft_notes: A correct, tidy form: a navy header with an amber rule, cream-filled boxes, amber required asterisks and helpful right-aligned hints. The fields work well (email, number and date validation). Execution is generic, with small inconsistencies: misaligned radio buttons in the blank form, no dropdown affordance, uneven row rhythm and an empty band above the footer.
GQFW.revision_notes: Instagram handle (required) was added between Email and Phone in the same row, so the row is now three columns. The slot options were changed to the six 30-minute slots. Widget order is performer_name, email, instagram, phone and so on. The sample shows @driftwoodquartet and 8:30–9:00. Nothing else moved: the other crops are pixel-identical in size and layout.

defects.what: The signature is an underline only while the date is a taller box than every other field, so the row mixes two field styles and two heights
The signature value is set at about twice the size of every other filled value, which looks out of scale
Dead band of about 0.8 in between the signature row and the footer rule
Filled values are light and small against tall boxes, with tight left padding (text starts about 5 pt from the border)

MHMI.craft_notes: Polished and on-brand: an embedded Plus Jakarta Sans, a strong navy header with an amber subtitle and rule, rounded light-grey boxes, and a well-organised grid that pairs number with slot and email with phone. The checkbox and radio rows sit on a shared four-column grid. Remaining issues are small: the mixed styling in the signature/date row, the oversized signature value and some empty space above the footer.
MHMI.revision_notes: All requests were met: a required instagram field labelled 'Instagram handle *' right after Email, the six 30-minute slot options, tab order email, instagram, phone and so on, and a sample with @driftwoodquartet and 8:30–9:00. Collateral reflow: Phone moved from beside Email onto its own half-width row, which left an orphaned right half. Everything below shifted about 85 px, and spacing was compressed, so the signature/date row now sits about 0.25 in above the footer rule and the dead space moved below the footer.

pairwise_round1.why: MHMI's embedded typeface, tighter grid (number and slot paired, aligned four-column option rows) and consistent controls read as designed, while GQFW has misaligned radio buttons, an arrowless dropdown and uneven row rhythm.
